files.description: Full HTML page containing mandatory disclosures including the EHI Export section — a paragraph describing the export as a ZIP archive plus a 7-row table listing export categories (Medical Records/C-CDA, X-Rays/DICOM, Scanned Images, Consults/PDF, Messages/EML, Forms/PDF, Financials/JSON). This is the entire EHI export documentation.

WordPress REST API JSON for the mandatory disclosure page. Contains the same content as the HTML page but in a structured JSON format with just the rendered content, making it easier to parse programmatically.

CY 2025 Real World Testing Results (23 pages). RWT Measure #3 covers b(10) EHI exports — reveals the metric is 'Number of C-CDA Batch Exports Sent' (31 exports in Q1 2025 across VA/MD/PA). Provides operational context for how the export is used in practice.
